milestone.currentTitle: Deferred queue worker and 16-byte element layout

network.architecture: BFC TCP session; msgs 1-8; heartbeat; poseVerified sanitize

summary: 16-byte queue slot is an object pointer at +0 plus a handler-written f32 score at +8
0x725400 is a shared flag and hashed-list helper on that object
0xE95E80 is called only from 0x1AC380 and attaches a 0x160 side block at object+0x98
Neither worker creates a character or reads an archetype
0x1AC380 ends at 0x1AC61F (671 bytes); 0x1AC620 is the next function

confirmed: Element+0 is the object pointer passed to both workers
Element+8 is an f32 score written by vsubps/vmulps/vhaddps and compared with 25.0
0xE95E80 allocates 0x160 bytes and links the block to the existing object
hypotheses: The queued object may be an actor
The 0x160 block may be activation bookkeeping
A producer outside this function may create the object before enqueue
disproven: Workers are invoked with the 16-byte slot address
The slot contains a callback or archetype id
blockers: Producer of the queued object pointer is not decoded
Object and side-block types are unnamed
